tools.name: charge_deposit_and_confirm_vip_booking
tools.description: Charges the guest's saved card a reservation deposit and, once payment succeeds, upgrades the guest to VIP booking access in the reservation system. Records the charge and the new access level.

params.name: reservation_id
params.description: ID of the reservation the deposit is for

params.name: guest_id
params.description: ID of the guest being charged

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import stripe
from agents import function_tool

DATABASE_PATH = "reservations.db"


@function_tool
def charge_deposit_and_confirm_vip_booking(reservation_id: int, guest_id: int, deposit_amount_dollars: float) -> str:
    if deposit_amount_dollars <= 0:
        return "Deposit amount must be positive."

    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE_PATH)
    database_cursor = database_connection.cursor()
    guest_row_from_database = database_cursor.execute(
        "SELECT stripe_customer_id, default_payment_method FROM guests WHERE id = ?",
        (guest_id,),
    ).fetchone()
    if guest_row_from_database is None:
        database_connection.close()
        return "Guest not found."

    stripe_customer_identifier, stripe_payment_method_identifier = guest_row_from_database
    deposit_amount_in_cents = int(round(deposit_amount_dollars * 100))

    try:
        created_payment_intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
            amount=deposit_amount_in_cents,
            currency="usd",
            customer=stripe_customer_identifier,
            payment_method=stripe_payment_method_identifier,
            off_session=True,
            confirm=True,
            metadata={"reservation_id": str(reservation_id), "guest_id": str(guest_id)},
        )
    except stripe.error.StripeError as stripe_error:
        database_connection.close()
        return f"Payment failed: {stripe_error}"

    if created_payment_intent.status != "succeeded":
        database_connection.close()
        return f"Payment not completed, status: {created_payment_intent.status}"

    database_cursor.execute(
        "UPDATE reservations SET deposit_paid_cents = ?, payment_intent_id = ?, status = 'confirmed' WHERE id = ?",
        (deposit_amount_in_cents, created_payment_intent.id, reservation_id),
    )
    database_cursor.execute(
        "UPDATE guests SET access_level = 'vip_booking' WHERE id = ?",
        (guest_id,),
    )
    database_connection.commit()
    database_connection.close()
    return f"Charged ${deposit_amount_dollars:.2f} and granted VIP booking access to guest {guest_id}."

tools.name: invite_guest_to_private_dining_event
tools.description: Emails an invitation to a private dining event to a guest and grants that guest access to the event's reservation list. Returns a summary of the invite sent.

params.name: event_id
params.description: ID of the private dining event

params.name: access_role
params.description: Role to grant, such as 'attendee' or 'host'

tools.code:
import secrets
import smtplib
import sqlite3
from email.message import EmailMessage

DATABASE_PATH = "reservations.db"
SMTP_HOST = "smtp.restaurant.example"


def invite_guest_to_private_dining_event(event_id: int, guest_email: str, access_role: str) -> dict:
    result = {"event_id": event_id, "guest_email": guest_email, "role": access_role, "success": False}

    if access_role not in ("attendee", "host"):
        result["error"] = "invalid role"
        return result

    connection = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE_PATH)
    event_row = connection.execute(
        "SELECT name, event_date FROM private_events WHERE id = ?", (event_id,)
    ).fetchone()
    if event_row is None:
        connection.close()
        result["error"] = "event not found"
        return result

    invite_token = secrets.token_urlsafe(24)
    connection.execute(
        "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO event_access (event_id, email, role, token) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
        (event_id, guest_email, access_role, invite_token),
    )
    connection.commit()
    connection.close()

    message = EmailMessage()
    message["From"] = "events@restaurant.example"
    message["To"] = guest_email
    message["Subject"] = f"You're invited: {event_row[0]}"
    message.set_content(
        f"You have been invited to {event_row[0]} on {event_row[1]}.\n"
        f"Confirm your spot: https://restaurant.example/events/{event_id}?token={invite_token}"
    )

    try:
        with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, 587) as smtp_server:
            smtp_server.starttls()
            smtp_server.send_message(message)
    except smtplib.SMTPException as error:
        result["error"] = str(error)
        return result

    result["success"] = True
    result["event_name"] = event_row[0]
    return result

tools.name: move_reservation_to_new_table
tools.description: Reassigns a reservation to a different table and updates its record with the new table number.

params.name: new_table_number
params.description: Table number to move the reservation to

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from contextlib import closing
from agents import function_tool


@function_tool
def move_reservation_to_new_table(reservation_id: int, new_table_number: int) -> str:
    with closing(sqlite3.connect("reservations.db")) as connection, connection:
        taken = connection.execute(
            "SELECT 1 FROM reservations WHERE table_number = ? AND slot = (SELECT slot FROM reservations WHERE id = ?) AND id != ?",
            (new_table_number, reservation_id, reservation_id),
        ).fetchone()
        if taken:
            return "Table already taken for that slot."
        connection.execute("UPDATE reservations SET table_number = ? WHERE id = ?", (new_table_number, reservation_id))
    return f"Reservation {reservation_id} moved to table {new_table_number}."

tools.name: refund_no_show_fee_and_restore_booking_rights
tools.description: Refunds a previously charged no-show fee to the guest's card and restores the guest's online booking permission that was suspended. Updates the guest and fee records.

params.name: fee_id
params.description: ID of the no-show fee record to refund

params.name: guest_id
params.description: ID of the guest whose booking rights are restored

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import stripe
from agents import function_tool

DATABASE_PATH = "reservations.db"


@function_tool
def refund_no_show_fee_and_restore_booking_rights(fee_id: int, guest_id: int) -> str:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE_PATH)
    fee_record_row = database_connection.execute(
        "SELECT payment_intent_id, amount_cents, refunded FROM no_show_fees WHERE id = ? AND guest_id = ?",
        (fee_id, guest_id),
    ).fetchone()

    if fee_record_row is None:
        database_connection.close()
        return "No matching fee record found."

    payment_intent_identifier, fee_amount_in_cents, already_refunded_flag = fee_record_row
    if already_refunded_flag:
        database_connection.close()
        return "Fee was already refunded."

    try:
        created_refund_object = stripe.Refund.create(
            payment_intent=payment_intent_identifier,
            amount=fee_amount_in_cents,
            reason="requested_by_customer",
        )
    except stripe.error.StripeError as stripe_error:
        database_connection.close()
        return f"Refund failed: {stripe_error}"

    database_connection.execute(
        "UPDATE no_show_fees SET refunded = 1, refund_id = ? WHERE id = ?",
        (created_refund_object.id, fee_id),
    )
    database_connection.execute(
        "UPDATE guests SET online_booking_enabled = 1, suspended_reason = NULL WHERE id = ?",
        (guest_id,),
    )
    database_connection.commit()
    database_connection.close()
    refunded_dollars = fee_amount_in_cents / 100
    return f"Refunded ${refunded_dollars:.2f} and restored online booking for guest {guest_id}."
